_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: eliza (build); words jessica
source: his 2026-11-02 13:44: "yeah lets make an elite Ashta to hunt at a natural site", after my read of his May PredatorHuntTarget and vanilla's Ashta -> Alpha Ashta
_note: HANDED TO JESSICA 2026-11-02 beside E2, his "we'll have both missions as options", after his play of E1 rebuilt alone: "yeah E1 worked fine, took me to a covered crater". A natural board site works; only three kinds exist (Covered Crater, Crystal Crater, Natural Archways). Placeholder words; hers replace them. NOT unbuilt: it stays.

ELITE TEST E1: the first `elite` on a defeat. The build clones PCM_Cheyenne_Akila_Ashta as duo_delvetest_e1_b1elite with vanilla's alpha swaps (challenge VeryHard, + Special_Boss, size up one) and its own name, and does NOT retarget the template chain as his May PredatorHuntTarget did.

What his play answers: (1) does a plain clone render, at all and as an Ashta (if not, the May retarget goes back in, and we know why it existed); (2) does it read as an elite: bigger, harder, the name on its health bar; (3) does the board place a NATURAL site on Akila (no Delve has pinned a planet AND required a theme).
Silent on purpose: no speaker, broadcast or say, so no voice spend. The words are placeholders for a probe, not Jessica's; if it graduates, a real recipe gets hers. Unbuilt once it has told us.

WORDS, Jessica 2026-11-02 on his ruling that BOTH are hers to write, as options. E1's angle is the den: he goes to its ground, where E2 has it come to ours. No line names the kind of place (Covered Crater, Crystal Crater or Natural Archways, Eliza's census), only that it is out in the wild. Bigger and older, never giant (one size step).
NARROW, as MB98a: pinned to Akila, so Ashta and the Rangers are said aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).

THE RANGER IN PERSON, his 14:37: she stands on the outskirts (RETravelA1) and briefs him in a talk; the broadcast went, since she says it to his face. Named persons are Essential since 11-02 (bc14c45), so the hunt cannot kill her.

place._theme: A natural landmark (his ask), 42% of the request pool by part 32's census; how many the content manager can put on Akila is the open question.

prose.name: Hunt: Elder Ashta at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: An Ashta bigger and older than the rest has taken the <Place> for its den, well away from anyone's walls. The Rangers want it put down before it starts coming in.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Hunt the Elder Ashta at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats._at: The edge of the site: she stands on the outskirts, not at the den.
beats.objective: Meet the Ranger on the edge of the <Place>
beats.journal: I met the Ranger on the edge of the <Place>. The Elder Ashta lies up in there, and I need to go in quiet and put it down.

person.name: Tamar Quill
hellos: Keep your voice down. It's close.

greeting: You came out. Good. The old one's in there, and it doesn't come to us yet. It lies up out here and takes whatever wanders past. Ask what you need, then go in quiet.

reply: Good. It'll know you're there before you see it, so don't stop moving.
Because there's one of me and a lot of ground to watch. And the last old one I went after alone, I nearly didn't walk back from.

exchanges.prompt: How do you know it's old?
reply: The size, and the scars. And it's patient. The young ones never are.

beats._at: Natural landmarks carry the wounded marker (part 32: REWounded + IS Natural, 102 in the cargo corpus); RECenterLocRef left a draw pool of 3.
beats._elite: The ordinary Ashta MB98a's waves proved renders when spawned bare. 'Elder Ashta' is a probe name, not vanilla's 'Alpha Ashta', so the two cannot be confused at the glass.
beats.objective: Hunt the Elder Ashta at the <Place>
beats.journal: I tracked the Elder Ashta to its den at the <Place> and put it down.
say: That's the old one down. I'll tell the homesteads they can let their stock out again.

_speech: An Akila Ranger, a woman, standing on the edge of the site (his 14:37: 'for E1 can we have the npc on the outskirts of the base standing there'), so the brief is a talk and only the close is radio, in her voice. Narrow, so Ashta and Rangers are said aloud. Voice borrowed until his ear casts it.
